text_en: Turning to the practical information, An adult ticket costs nine pounds; the figure of twelve on our old poster included a boat trip that is not running today.
As for booking details, The next guided tour begins at 10:40, rather than half past ten as the brochure suggests.
There is also a useful change to note: If you want to hear the recorded sailors’ interviews, collect headphones from the guide; the recordings are not played over loudspeakers.
Before you arrive, remember this: School groups should confirm their numbers by Wednesday so we can prepare the practical equipment.

If you have spare time, there is a free lookout on the upper floor; it is not part of the labelled plan for this exercise. The visitor team at Harbour Maritime Centre will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
As for booking details, Replacing a lost library card now costs three pounds, although renewing an existing card is still free.
There is also a useful change to note: Computer sessions are limited to 45 minutes during the exam period; the old one-hour rule no longer applies.
Before you arrive, remember this: The picture-book event is held on Saturday, not on Sunday as the first newsletter announced.
Turning to the practical information, For photocopying and printing, buy tokens at reception rather than putting cash directly into the machines.

Please ask a librarian before moving any of the mobile display boards; the route needs to stay clear for wheelchair access. The visitor team at Alderbrook Community Library will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
There is also a useful change to note: The ranger-led walk lasts 75 minutes, not the two hours listed on the older leaflet.
Before you arrive, remember this: Please reach the visitor desk by 8:15 if you have booked the dawn survey.
Turning to the practical information, Wear waterproof boots; ordinary trainers are unsuitable because the lower path remains muddy.
As for booking details, The field classroom closes every Monday for equipment checks, but the outside route stays open.
If you notice a damaged fence, report its location to the visitor desk instead of trying to cross it. The visitor team at Birchwood Nature Reserve will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
Before you arrive, remember this: A single taster session costs six pounds. The nine-pound figure on the booking site is for a supervised climbing lesson.
Turning to the practical information, Online registration closes on Thursday evening; walk-in places are not guaranteed.
As for booking details, You must be at least 14 to join the open climbing session, even with an adult present.
There is also a useful change to note: Bring your own towel; mats and safety harnesses can be borrowed on site.

Staff will announce any last-minute changes at the membership desk; the information screens may update a little later. The visitor team at Larkspur Leisure Complex will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
Turning to the practical information, The public clay demonstration starts at 2:20, not at two o’clock as the early programme said.
As for booking details, The bookable textile workshop costs eleven pounds including materials.
There is also a useful change to note: Photography spaces are released for booking each Tuesday, rather than at the weekend.
Before you arrive, remember this: Please keep your receipt if you plan to collect a fired ceramic piece next week.

Paintings in the temporary display are not for sale through the front desk; speak to the individual artists instead. The visitor team at Crescent City Arts House will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
As for booking details, No more than 18 people may enter the research greenhouse together because the walkway is narrow.
There is also a useful change to note: The volunteer plant clinic now runs on Friday; Thursday sessions were discontinued in October.
Before you arrive, remember this: The seed exchange is free, though donations towards postage are welcome.
Turning to the practical information, Please bring a paper bag for collected seeds, not a plastic container that may trap moisture.
Do not remove labels from any specimens: some plants in the research collection look almost identical. The visitor team at Pinehill Botanic Garden will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
There is also a useful change to note: Each simulator session lasts 20 minutes, even though the demonstration video is only twelve minutes long.
Before you arrive, remember this: Last admission is at 4:15, a quarter of an hour earlier than the museum itself closes.
Turning to the practical information, The secure lockers take a refundable deposit of two pounds; they are not free to open.
As for booking details, Teachers should send group changes by email rather than leaving a telephone message.

If you are photographing the restoration bay, please do so from behind the marked public line. The visitor team at North Quay Transport Heritage Hall will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
Before you arrive, remember this: The first supervised feeding starts at 11:25, once the animals have returned from their morning check.
Turning to the practical information, Every booked family receives a voucher worth five pounds for the produce stall, not a cash refund.
As for booking details, Children must be at least eight to take part in the knife-skills workshop.
There is also a useful change to note: Please bring a reusable bag if you plan to take produce home; we no longer offer disposable ones.
The farm machinery behind the tool shed is in use, so it is not part of the public tour. The visitor team at Maplewood Community Farm will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
Turning to the practical information, The robot demonstration begins at 1:35; please ignore the 1:15 time printed on last month’s flyer.
As for booking details, The maker workshop accepts groups of 12, because the tables are shared in pairs.
There is also a useful change to note: Reserve your experiment slot online before arriving; tickets are no longer issued at the door.
Before you arrive, remember this: Closed shoes are essential for the energy workshop; sandals are not permitted.

The space dome can become dark without warning during a demonstration, so follow the guide’s instructions. The visitor team at Silverbrook Science Discovery Centre will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
As for booking details, The complete introductory tour takes 55 minutes, not the ninety minutes quoted for the specialist excavation walk.
There is also a useful change to note: The children’s pottery workshop is held on Sunday mornings.
Before you arrive, remember this: We suggest a contribution of four pounds for the craft materials, although access to the park is free.
Turning to the practical information, Bring a notebook if you want to record the reconstructed house’s building methods.
Take care on the gravel paths after rain, particularly near the reconstructed house. The visitor team at East Meadow Heritage Park will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
There is also a useful change to note: Each health talk lasts 25 minutes, followed by a short question session.
Before you arrive, remember this: Bring your booking code for the screening appointments rather than a paper ticket.
Turning to the practical information, The advice clinic starts at 9:45; the hall itself opens at nine.
As for booking details, There is a suggested donation of two pounds for the community transport fund, but entry is free.
Please respect the privacy of anyone speaking to staff in the advice areas. The visitor team at Orchard Lane Health & Wellbeing Fair will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
Before you arrive, remember this: Each repair consultation has a slot of 30 minutes; complex work may require a second appointment.
Turning to the practical information, The market closes at 5:20 today, slightly earlier than the usual evening finish.
As for booking details, The design demonstration requires a ticket costing three pounds, which includes materials.
There is also a useful change to note: You need the numbered tag to collect anything left at the repair cafe.
For lost property, speak to the help desk rather than contacting individual stallholders. The visitor team at Westmill Makers Market will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
Turning to the practical information, Each telescope group has ten visitors, allowing everyone time to look through the equipment.
As for booking details, Please check in by 7:10, or your place may be offered to someone on the waiting list.
There is also a useful change to note: The weather cancellation update will arrive by text message, not by email.
Before you arrive, remember this: Bring a warm coat; even summer evenings can be cold on the open deck.
Any photographs taken on the viewing deck must be made without flash. The visitor team at Redstone Observatory Visitor Night will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
As for booking details, The induction begins at 8:50, ten minutes before the first practical group leaves.
There is also a useful change to note: Anyone joining the canoe session must swim 25 metres without stopping.
Before you arrive, remember this: Keep your coloured wristband on throughout the day so staff can identify your group.
Turning to the practical information, A refundable deposit of five pounds is collected for a locker key.
Tell your instructor immediately if any item of safety equipment appears damaged. The visitor team at Riverstone Outdoor Education Base will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
There is also a useful change to note: Doors open at 6:25, not half past six as printed on the first batch of tickets.
Before you arrive, remember this: Students receive a reduction of four pounds on the standard concert ticket.
Turning to the practical information, Instruments borrowed for home practice may be kept for one week.
As for booking details, You must show photo ID when collecting a reserved instrument.
Please keep mobile phones on silent near the recording booth, even while waiting outside. The visitor team at Seaport Music & Performance Hub will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
Before you arrive, remember this: Visitors need to be at least ten years old for the machinery tour.
Turning to the practical information, The guided tour begins at 11:10, after the daily safety inspection.
As for booking details, Visitors are given protective glasses at reception and must wear them in the sorting area.
There is also a useful change to note: Reusable furniture collection is arranged on Friday afternoons only.
Large batteries cannot be left in the ordinary bins; ask the team for separate disposal advice. The visitor team at Meadow Gate Recycling Centre will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
Turning to the practical information, The next simulated-tide demonstration is at 3:05, after the school group leaves.
As for booking details, A printed coastal learning pack costs two pounds; the downloadable version is free.
There is also a useful change to note: Binoculars can be borrowed at the counter, subject to a refundable deposit.
Before you arrive, remember this: The longer ranger talk is now offered on Wednesday instead of Thursday.

The cafe does not provide packed lunches for coastal walks, but drinking water is available near the exit. The visitor team at Cliffside Coastal Visitor Centre will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
As for booking details, The guided archive tour lasts 65 minutes, including a short projection at the end.
There is also a useful change to note: Next month’s tour places are released on Monday morning.
Before you arrive, remember this: To photograph collection items for a project, you need written consent from the archive manager.
Turning to the practical information, The audio-guide headset requires a refundable deposit of three pounds.

If you have any questions about a donated film, ask the archivist rather than handling the original reels. The visitor team at Cypress Theatre & Film Archive will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
There is also a useful change to note: The beginner baking workshop costs eight pounds; ingredients are included.
Before you arrive, remember this: The compulsory food safety briefing starts at 9:20, before any kitchen work.
Turning to the practical information, Return your allergy form to the tutor even if you have no known allergies.
As for booking details, The tasting class is capped at 16 participants to keep the preparation area clear.
Please leave hot equipment in its designated area rather than carrying it between rooms. The visitor team at Southfield Food Education Centre will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
Before you arrive, remember this: Our family tour begins at 12:15, when the morning research session has finished.
Turning to the practical information, A single archive photocopy costs one pound, regardless of the page size.
As for booking details, Long research appointments must be requested by Thursday each week.
There is also a useful change to note: Use a pencil for signing the archive forms; ink pens are not allowed near the originals.
As you leave, you can collect a short printed timeline from the information desk. The visitor team at Briar Hill Local History Centre will answer any remaining questions after the tour.
